name: Mastodon
label: Mastodon REST — statuses, home timeline, search
description: Official Mastodon REST on a fixed instance origin (api_spec baseUrl https://mastodon.social). OfficialApiNode: POST /api/v1/statuses, GET /api/v1/statuses/{status_id}, GET /api/v1/timelines/home, GET /api/v2/search, GET /api/v1/accounts/verify_credentials. Auth is StudioQuack secret access_token (Bearer). trigger is BPMN message-event ingress, not a socket. Customer owns the instance account. Never log access_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. No secrets. media is type file (platform ref-id). Example: {"status":"Hello","visibility":"public"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: status_create | status_get | timeline_get | search | account_get | trigger.

schema.label: instance_host
schema.description: Mastodon instance hostname only (no scheme). Interpolated as https://{instance_host}. Example: mastodon.social.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Status text for status_create. Official status. Max 500 chars on default servers.

schema.label: visibility
schema.description: status_create visibility. EXACT: public | unlisted | private | direct.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Search query for search. Official q.

schema.label: type
schema.description: search type. EXACT: accounts | hashtags | statuses.

schema.label: spoiler_text
schema.description: Content warning for status_create. Official spoiler_text.

schema.label: language
schema.description: ISO 639 language for status_create. Example: en.

schema.label: media_ids
schema.description: Attachment ids for status_create. Official media_ids.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). trigger returns an ingress instruction, not HTTP. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (status, timeline array, search buckets, or account).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: status_create | status_get | timeline_get | search | account_get | trigger.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Mastodon user access token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT. Empty → no HTTP.

configurationParameters.label: Instance Host
configurationParameters.description: Mastodon instance hostname only (no scheme). Default mastodon.social. Example: mastodon.social.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
